desc: Implement the solution in Python with the `Solution` class. Precompute `prefAbs` array of size `(n+1) x 26`. Initialize `dp` array with infinity, and `bestVal` and `bestJ` arrays for each character (initialized to `0` and `-1` for `j=-1`). Iterate `i` from 0 to `n-1`, compute `dp[i]` using the pool, update the pool with `j = i` after computing `dp[i]`. Reconstruct the string by backtracking from `n-1` using the stored choices.
Test additional edge cases: already good strings, n<3, n=3, strings with multiple optimal partitions.
